change: board 429: four news articles whose practice questions graded the right answer wrong. The recursion guide (Q3 keyed 11, the method returns 12; Q2 had no true option until its base case returns the empty string; Q4 and Q1 keyed options that claimed something false), CSP day 29 on two handles (keyed 99 and taught aliasing where the Exam Reference Sheet says list assignment copies), and CSA unit 2 day 20 (the loop prints 10 and no option said so). One Matrixify Blog Posts sheet, four rows.
_context: NOTHING HERE REACHES A STUDENT UNTIL A HUMAN IMPORTS ONE SHEET.
Merging deploys the API and changes nothing the API does. The change that
matters is the import of imports/2026-09-25-news-wrong-keys/
news-wrong-keys-repair-blog-posts.csv, and the only way to know it happened
is to read the four live articles afterwards.
scripts/verify-news-wrong-keys-live.js is FALSE BEFORE and true after, and
was measured both ways on 2026-09-25: against the live pages, 3 ok and 13
failed, and in Chromium the recursion guide rejects the right answer to Q3
and day 29 rejects B on both handles; with --simulate-import, 16 ok. The
three ok before the import are the day 29 pages carrying no self-correction
and the day 20 grader already keying B, whose VALUE was wrong, not its
letter; the verifier says so in its header.
THE SUITE DOES NOT TRUST A KEY TABLE. It re-derives every answer by running
the repaired page's own code: javac for the recursion guide and day 20,
lib/csp-pseudocode.js for day 29. For a which-describes-the-error question
it applies the fix each option implies and asks whether the method then
agrees with a reference over every input tried. The sweep that found these
tested only whether grader, label and explanation agree, and that is why it
saw one of the three broken questions on the recursion guide.
THE REDERIVE IS PHASE PRE: the generator is find-or-refuse, so once the
repairs are live it must refuse to build. After the import, the live check
is what re-derives.
